translations.web: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
translations.bsb: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me— the breath of life I have made.
translations.kjv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
translations.asv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls that I have made.
